cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 61% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.25% · WTI +2.89% · Brent -1.98% · NatGas +12.42%. 61% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.36%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.36%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.31%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +16.91%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +16.91%, EOSE +5.77%, BE +4.48%, PWR +4.35%, ARRY +3.39%. Laggards: ENPH -16.33%, SEDG -8.77%, BKR -7.12%, NOV -5.99%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.36% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
